lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the CAM-433 round-1 CRITICAL finding at src/supervisor/worker-dispatch.ts:43: workerOutLogPath writes `<claudeDir>/cam-worker-out-<phase>-<uuid>.log` (no leading dot), which was not covered by the pre-existing `.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log` (WITH a leading dot) gitignore entry. Chose the gitignore-registration fix (not a rename to the dotted stem) because there is exact precedent for an undotted pipe-pane-out-log glob two lines below in both files: `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log` (CAM-158/CAM-160, plan-runner's own out-log). Added the literal glob `.claude/cam-worker-out-*.log` to BOTH .gitignore and templates/.gitignore immediately after the legacy dotted entry, with a comment distinguishing the two conventions, then ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts and confirmed `embed-vendor:check` is clean. Verified empirically with `git check-ignore -v` on both `.claude/cam-worker-out-implementer-x.log` (now correctly ignored) and `.claude/.cam-worker-out-implementer-x.log` (still ignored, unaffected). No source/behavior code changed, only the two gitignore files plus the generated vendor embed and a patterns.md bullet. Remaining review round 1 findings still open in prd.json for future stories: US-R1-002 (plan-runner.ts:463 bare dispatch-failed literal breaks its own US-002 grep oracle), US-R1-003 (revert the jsLiteral special-case encoding + rescope the oracle away from generated output), US-R1-004 (four stale 'pure function/no I/O' module-header docstrings in worker-argv.ts/plan-argv.ts/review.ts now contradict buildSpawnArgv's file I/O), US-R1-005 (verified-dispatch.ts's @cam_label uses the raw sentinel phase string, e.g. 'implementer-timeout', which isSessionStale doesn't recognize as a worker label and can cause a healthy post-timeout session to be torn down as stale on the next `cam run`). None of the review's SUGGESTION-severity findings (task-prompt-file.ts fail-open cat, reap-before-validate ordering, hardcoded '-L cam' literals instead of tmuxArgs(), untested DispatchFailureReason variants, plan-runner.ts module-split suggestion, project.toml operator-config-drift-in-feature-commit) were filed as separate prd.json stories; they remain only in prd.review.findings as non-blocking record.
